items.title: Mike De Lay Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: So he came down one day, he called me, he talked, he said, son you play nice. He said, but you shouldn't copy behind people so much.

ctx.x: Can you tell more about his style? Because John said Buddy Pt, that you play like him sometimes, you play a little chorus and

all that. Buddy Pt, well, what I would say was a lot of, in those days they used to call it runs, we call them chords nowadays, you know, breaking chords, you know what I mean? Because you get to, in later years we studied those things and we actually properly, in other words, probably naturally knew what we were doing. You would put it that way, you understand what I mean? So I just, I had an idea, I always wanted to play on that type, just a lot of execution. And even before, even before I knew, I knew too…
